# PDF export dependencies

Loaded only when an organizer generates a schedule PDF. Participant data stays in the browser.

- pdf-lib 1.17.1: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT, see pdf-lib-LICENSE.md).
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT; upstream license in fontkit-LICENSE.txt).
- Noto Sans Regular and Bold: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts (SIL Open Font License, see NotoSans-LICENSE.txt).

The fonts are embedded as subsets to preserve names with diacritics in small, printable PDFs.
